mapper.insert: insert into orders (number, status, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, checkout_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, user_name, phone, address, consignee) values (#{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{userName}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{consignee});

insert into order_detail (order_id, dish_id, name, setmeal_id, dish_flavor, number, amount, image) values
(#{orderDetail.orderId}, #{orderDetail.dishId}, #{orderDetail.name}, #{orderDetail.setmealId}, #{orderDetail.dishFlavor}, #{orderDetail.number}, #{orderDetail.amount}, #{orderDetail.image})
